faqs.question: What are the OPD timings?
faqs.answer: Our Outpatient Department (OPD) operates Monday through Saturday from 08:00 AM to 08:00 PM. Emergency services remain open 24/7.
faqs.answer_hinglish: Humara OPD Monday se Saturday subah 8:00 baje se raat 8:00 baje tak khula rehta hai. Emergency services 24 ghante uplabdh hain.

faqs.question: How can I book an appointment?
faqs.question_hinglish: Appointment kaise book kar sakte hain?
faqs.answer: You can book an appointment using this voice assistant, through our website, or by calling our helpdesk at +91-11-2659-4000.
faqs.answer_hinglish: Aap is voice assistant ke zariye, humari website par jakar, ya helpdesk number +91-11-2659-4000 par call karke appointment book kar sakte hain.

faqs.question: Can I cancel or reschedule my appointment?
faqs.question_hinglish: Kya main appointment cancel ya reschedule kar sakta hoon?
faqs.answer: Yes, appointments can be cancelled or rescheduled at least 2 hours before the scheduled time slot without any penalty.
faqs.answer_hinglish: Haan, aap scheduled time se kam se kam 2 ghante pehle appointment bina kisi charge ke cancel ya reschedule kar sakte hain.

faqs.question: Where is the hospital located?
faqs.answer: Sanjeevani Multispeciality Hospital is located at Plot 14, Institutional Area, Sector 5, Dwarka, New Delhi 110075, near Dwarka Sector 11 Metro Station.
faqs.answer_hinglish: Hospital Plot 14, Institutional Area, Sector 5, Dwarka, New Delhi 110075 mein sthit hai, Dwarka Sector 11 Metro Station ke paas.

faqs.question: What documents should I bring for my consultation?
faqs.question_hinglish: Doctor ke paas aate waqt kaunse documents laane honge?
faqs.answer: Please carry a valid government-issued photo ID (such as Aadhaar or Voter ID), any prior medical reports, and current prescriptions.
faqs.answer_hinglish: Kripya ek valid photo ID (jaise Aadhaar ya Voter ID), purani medical reports, aur chalu dawaiyon ki prescription saath layein.

faqs.question: Are emergency services available at night?
faqs.question_hinglish: Kya raat ko emergency services chalu rehti hain?
faqs.answer: Yes, our Emergency and Trauma Care unit is fully operational 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, with dedicated on-call doctors and ambulance support.
faqs.answer_hinglish: Ji haan, humari Emergency aur Trauma unit 24 ghante aur saaton din khuli rehti hai, ambulance aur emergency doctors ke saath.
